title: Mid-Term Resize of a Harborline VPS
content:
## Rule

A resize may be made only while the server status is active. A VPS in the VPS and Dedicated Servers range may be resized only up to one of the tiers its own tier can be resized up to mid-term, with about the tier's expected resize downtime, and never down, because disks cannot shrink. Dedicated servers are never resized; a larger dedicated server is a new order.

## The resize charge

The resize is billed as the target's price for the current term length minus the current tier's, times the months of the term, times the calendar days from today to the term end date over the calendar days of the term, rounded half up to the cent.

The three quantities are defined as follows:

- **Price difference per month:** the target tier's price per month for the current term length less the current tier's price per month for that same term length. On a 12-month term both prices are the 12-month prices; on a 1-month term both are the 1-month prices.
- **Remaining days:** the calendar days from today to the term end date.
- **Term days:** the calendar days from the term start date to the term end date.

The charge is the price difference per month, multiplied by the months of the term, multiplied by the remaining days, divided by the term days, rounded once half up to the cent at the end. It is billed as a resize proration line covering the period to the term end, and the server's product becomes the target tier.

## Points of judgement

| Situation | Outcome |
|---|---|
| Active VPS, target listed for its tier | Resize may be made |
| Active VPS, target not listed for its tier | No resize to that target |
| Target is a smaller tier | No resize: disks cannot shrink |
| VPS not active, for example suspended or cancel pending | No resize |
| Dedicated server | Never resized; a larger dedicated server is a new order |

## Hypothetical worked figure

All prices and dates below are invented inputs, not Harborline figures. A VPS is on a 12-month term of 365 days with 73 days left to the term end. The target tier's hypothetical 12-month price per month exceeds the current tier's by 13.00. 13.00 multiplied by 12 is 156.00; 156.00 multiplied by 73 and divided by 365 is 31.20. The resize line is 31.20.
